item.title: The 'Nihilist Penguin' Meme Full Explanation
item.description: The meme known as "Penguin Walking Toward Mountain," often called "Nihilist Penguin," comes from Encounters at the End of the World, a documentary directed by Werner Herzog. In one memorable scene, an Adélie penguin abruptly turns away from its colony and begins walking alone toward the interior of Antarctica, a journey that would inevitably lead to its death.

item.title: MMA Fighter Islam Makhachev's Advice About Sending Your Son '2-3 Years Dagestan' To Toughen Up Becomes A Meme
item.description: Send Him 2-3 Years Dagestan and Forget is a viral video of Russian MMA fighter Islam Makhachev saying, "If you want your son high level wrestling, send him 2-3 years Dagestan and forget."
